verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI supports natural-language-like querying via CLI (`crwl ... -q "Extract all product prices"`) and offers MCP integration for connecting to AI tools like Claude Code, enabling agentic/NL-driven use. However, this is limited to specific query-extraction flags and MCP hooks rather than a full conversational NL interface, and community feedback notes new users struggle to configure these integrations in practice.
